items.statement: The investigation uses CCDC 2433822 for compound 1 with explicit mapping, charge and multiplicity.
items.expected: CCDC 2433822, neutral singlet and reproducible mapping are reported.

items.statement: The selected candidate is validated by vibrational analysis and coverage/stopping is documented.
items.expected: Per-candidate validation, imaginary-mode count and stopping statement are reported.

items.statement: The free ligand optimized structure is reported as a local minimum with no imaginary frequencies.
items.expected: Conclusion reports stationary-point status and observed imaginary-mode count.

items.statement: Free-ligand bond lengths agree closely with crystal data; reported RMSE is 0.004 Å and R² is 0.998.
items.expected: Mapped bond table and aggregate metrics are supplied with scope limitations.
